QUOTE: "Token counting is the most silent path. `do_count_tokens` returns 0 (`:825`), which `InferenceBackend::count_tokens` passes on (`backend.cpp:496`)... A failed count looks like "zero tokens," so a plugin doing budget math sees plenty of room."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the token-counting path returns 0 on tokenization failure instead of signalling an error.
